name: Klarna
description: Read Klarna merchant orders and settlement payouts from any AI agent: one order with captures and refunds, list payouts by date, and list settlement transactions by payout or order. HTTP Basic auth, Europe / North America / Oceania, live or Playground.
instructions:
## Klarna
This connector talks to Klarna's **Order Management API** and **Settlements API** on the host you pick in `KLARNA_API_URL` (Europe, North America or Oceania; live or Playground). It is **read-only**: it never captures, refunds, cancels or changes an order.

**Setup (about 5 minutes)**
1. Sign in to the Klarna Merchant Portal for the environment you want (Playground for tests, live for production).
2. Create an API credential. Klarna shows a **username** (often a UUID) and a **password** / API key once; copy them into `KLARNA_USERNAME` and `KLARNA_PASSWORD`.
3. Set `KLARNA_API_URL` to the host that matches that credential's region and environment (see the Environment options). A Playground key only works on a `*.playground.klarna.com` host; a live key only on a live host.

**Authentication**: HTTP Basic with the Merchant Portal username and password. The connector sends them as `Authorization: Basic …` on every call.

**Where to start**
- One order: `klarna_get_order` with Klarna's `order_id` (not your shop number; that is `merchant_reference1` on the order). Returns status, amounts (authorized / captured / refunded / remaining), expiry, lines, captures and refunds. Amounts are integers in **minor units** (10000 = 100.00 of the currency).
- Money that hit the bank: `klarna_list_payouts` for a date range (and optional currency), then `klarna_list_transactions` with each payout's `payment_reference` (or with an `order_id`) for the SALE / FEE / RETURN lines.

**Dates and paging**: settlement `start_date` / `end_date` are ISO-8601 date-times; a bare date means midnight, so use e.g. `2026-09-30T23:59:59Z` to include that day. `klarna_list_transactions` has **no date filter** in Klarna's API: list payouts for the period first, then pass each `payment_reference`. Both list tools page with `size` (default 20) and `offset`.

**Limits**: read-only here. Captures, refunds, cancels, dispute handling and payment-session creation stay in the Merchant Portal or another connector. 401 means the username/password or host is wrong for that credential; 404 means no such order or payout in this account.
prerequisites: A Klarna merchant account and an API credential (username and password) from the Merchant Portal for the region and environment you will use. About 5 minutes.

KLARNA_API_URL.label: Environment
KLARNA_API_URL.help: Klarna host for your merchant region's live or Playground API. The credential must belong to the same environment.
KLARNA_API_URL.patternMessage: Pick one of Klarna's six API hosts (EU / NA / OC, live or Playground), without a trailing slash.

KLARNA_USERNAME.label: API username
KLARNA_USERNAME.help: Merchant Portal → Settings → API credentials: the username shown next to the API key (often a UUID).
KLARNA_USERNAME.patternMessage: Paste the API username only, without spaces.

KLARNA_PASSWORD.label: API password
KLARNA_PASSWORD.help: Merchant Portal → Settings → API credentials: the API key / password shown when the credential was created.
KLARNA_PASSWORD.patternMessage: Paste the API password / key only, without spaces.

verifyHints.401: Klarna refused the username or password. Copy them again from the Merchant Portal and check that KLARNA_API_URL matches the credential (Playground keys only on *.playground.klarna.com, live keys only on the live hosts).
verifyHints.403: This API credential is not allowed to call this endpoint. Create a credential with Order Management and Settlements access in the Merchant Portal.
verifyHints.404: Klarna found no order or payout with that id in this account. Order ids are Klarna's own ids, not your shop's order number.
verifyHints.auth_failed: Klarna refused Basic auth. Check KLARNA_USERNAME, KLARNA_PASSWORD and that KLARNA_API_URL is the host for that credential.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Klarna is rate limiting this credential. Wait a moment and try again.

tools.name: klarna_get_order
tools.description: Get one Klarna order by Klarna order_id: status (AUTHORIZED, PART_CAPTURED, CAPTURED, CANCELLED, EXPIRED, CLOSED), order_amount, captured_amount, refunded_amount, remaining_authorized_amount, expires_at, order lines, captures, refunds, merchant references and addresses. Amounts are integers in minor units (10000 = 100.00). Your shop's order number is merchant_reference1, not order_id. Read-only.

order_id.description: Klarna order id (Klarna's id, not your shop order number).

tools.name: klarna_list_payouts
tools.description: List Klarna payouts (settlements to your bank) with totals per payout: sale, fee, return, holdback, reversal, tax and settlement amounts in minor units, plus payment_reference (the bank-statement reference). Filter by payout start_date and end_date (ISO-8601 date-times; a bare date is midnight, so end with T23:59:59Z to include that day) and optional currency_code. Paginated with size (default 20) and offset. Read-only.

start_date.description: Optional. ISO-8601 date or date-time lower bound for the payout (e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z).

end_date.description: Optional. ISO-8601 date or date-time upper bound for the payout (e.g. 2026-09-30T23:59:59Z to include 30 Sep).

currency_code.description: Optional. ISO 4217 currency code to filter by (e.g. EUR, SEK, USD).

offset.description: How many payouts to skip before the first returned (default 0).

tools.name: klarna_list_transactions
tools.description: List Klarna settlement transactions (SALE, RETURN, FEE, REVERSAL and similar) with amount in minor units, order id, capture/refund ids, merchant references and payment_reference. Filter by payment_reference (a payout from klarna_list_payouts) and/or order_id. Klarna's API has no date filter on this endpoint: for a period, list payouts first and pass each payment_reference. Paginated with size (default 20) and offset. Read-only.

payment_reference.description: Optional. Payout reference (from klarna_list_payouts or the bank statement) to filter transactions.

order_id.description: Optional. Klarna order id to filter transactions for that order.

offset.description: How many transactions to skip before the first returned (default 0).
